mechanism: Topiramate causes hyperchloremic metabolic acidosis and renal potassium wasting through carbonic anhydrase inhibition, increasing risk of hypokalemia when combined with potassium supplementation or increasing hyperkalemia risk if baseline acidosis is severe.
action: Monitor serum potassium and acid-base status regularly; adjust potassium supplementation based on levels; consider alternative antiepileptic if persistent electrolyte abnormalities occur.
